name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Fixes a real Jellyfin admin-equivalent API key silently leaking on every unrelated Federation settings save. This server mints one internal API key for itself (InternalRelayApiKey) to relay Direct-mode streams locally over loopback - meant to be created once and reused forever. But the config-save endpoint's preserve-on-save list never protected it, so any general settings save wiped it back to empty; the next stream request then saw no key on file and minted a brand new real Jellyfin API key, abandoning the old one for good. Confirmed live: three of these orphaned in a single day of ordinary config saves, each showing up as an unexplained new entry under Dashboard > API Keys. InternalRelayApiKey is now preserved exactly like every other server-internal field, so it's minted once per server and never again.

215 tests (unchanged).
